externalDependencies.detail: No verified external payment rail is available in this environment. Runs settle through 'local-ledger', a team-controlled, explicitly labeled merchant adapter. Reports mark settlement local_only and never present unconfirmed payment as settled. Missing proof: live merchant order id, rail name, signed receipt, amount and network for a real paid reservation.

Separate enrolled org identities are enforced and reported, but both orgs are operated by the same local owner in this build. A production claim needs a genuinely independent operator plus a verified commercial rail.

Seatbelt isolation is fail-closed with split probes: capabilityProbe (/usr/bin/true under a minimal profile) detects unsupported hosts; policyProbe (node -e 0 under the exact run profile) detects policy defects — a policy failure returns 500 SANDBOX_POLICY_FAILED and fails tests, never classified 'unsupported'. Read scope: node install, /System/Library, /usr/lib, dyld cryptex/cache dirs (/System/Cryptexes, /private/preboot/Cryptexes, /var/db/dyld), literal '/' for dyld CacheFinder bootstrap (directory literal grants no file contents), recipe dir, mounted inputs, /dev devices. Writes scoped to the fenced workspace; network denied. Host verified: baseline /usr/bin/true probe succeeds; node bootstrap previously SIGABRTed in dyld CacheFinder — fixed via the literal '/' grant pending recipe recheck. This build sandbox cannot sandbox_apply, so contained execution + scope-denial probe (test/m04-leases.test.js 'M04: seatbelt scope') remain host-gated skips here. Demo no longer auto-overrides: default run requires sandbox-exec:no-network to claim success and exits 1 with a BLOCKED step otherwise.
